value.rationale: The claim determines a natural structural invariant for a classical slowly synchronizing family over an all-\(n\) parameter range, including unique optimal words and the exact first saturation point. It adds information not encoded by the known full reset threshold and is neither a routine renaming nor an arbitrary finite slice.
